This should already be mostly answered in https://github.com/algolia/docsearch/issues/457, but a sync between both of the projects is already planned. However, it's something that will be implemented in Docsearch, and not in InstantSearch.js, so for that reason I'll close this issue and leave the discussion in the other issue. I hope that makes sense to you 😄
